svg.aria-label: A vertical flow: automation degrades; the system falls back automatically to a slow, bounded safe mode; people are shown the full picture; a person proposes an action; an independent check asks whether it is consistent with reality. If not, it refuses, explains and escalates. If so, the system proceeds in degraded mode, then restores full automation and verifies. A bracket notes the whole path is rehearsed in drills
svg.text: A handover designed as a system
what a recovery path looks like when it is built, not improvised
a fault, lost data, an uncertain state
Fall back to a safe mode
automatic, slow, bounded: the 40 km/h rule
where everything is; what the system knew
rehearsed in drills, not invented on the day
the same check applies to commands from people and from machines
